description.to:
Outcome: A written cost model with measured numbers, so pricing in Prospectus has a floor. Fixed shared costs (distribution, KeyValueStore, wildcard certificate, the shared newsroom app, the shared backend's idle cost) and per-tenant costs: storage (S3 GB-month of the tenant prefix), requests and bytes served, CloudFront Function and KVS reads per request, projection (Lambda GB-seconds, S3 PUTs per publish), AppSync requests per editor action, DynamoDB reads and writes, model spend, invalidation paths, outbound email. Measured on the staging stack with a small tenant (10 stories a week) and a busy one (MoM-like: monitors delivering about 30 References a run). Prices are list prices to be checked at the time of writing.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (cost section) or a new docs/shared-tier-costs.md; request meter output; CloudWatch; Cost Explorer by tag.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: none (a document); its numbers feed features_backend/tenant-usage-counters.feature):
Scenario: The model explains a month of a small tenant
    Given the staging small tenant ran for 7 days
    When the cost model is applied to its counters
    Then the estimate is within 20% of the tagged cost

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-4a79f9, PPY-49d059. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Comparison with Cost Explorer by tag for the staging account.
Rollout: Document only.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a busy tenant's monitors dominate cost in ways the model misses. Mitigation: measure the busy profile, not only the small one.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
